title: Faithfulness of Verbalized Confidence vs Hidden Sandbagging

original_idea.body: # Faithfulness of Verbalized Confidence vs Hidden Sandbagging. Compare a model's calibration curve under sandbagging vs honest conditions; test whether calibration-mismatch detects sandbagging behaviorally.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Black-box sandbagging detector for API auditors; clear chain to dangerous-capability eval reliability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt for answer+confidence, compare calibration curves; accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped calibration-under-sandbagging comparison with clear detection metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: External-auditor tool for API models, no internal access; labs deprioritize third-party auditing.

novelty.reasoning: Sandbagging detection studied; confidence-faithfulness signal plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Calibration-mismatch as sandbagging detector plausibly under-explored.
